scope: Read-only upstream/source audit and isolated input preparation; no hardware access, no live kernel edits, no Git commit.

recommendation.reason: The final 5.4.302 PSI implementation has global and cgroup reading/threshold interfaces but still misses CPU quota/competing-cgroup accounting and multiple post-5.4 correctness/lifetime fixes. Pin 5.15.222 functionality and explicitly adapt subsequent applicable fixes; neither old stable branch is a complete security answer on its own.

artifacts.validation: Source review only. Compile, QEMU stress and ABI gates belong to root integration.

upstream_commits.title: CPU pressure for cpu.max and competing cgroups
upstream_commits.reason: Track TSK_ONCPU at schedule switch; NR_RUNNING>1 alone misses external competition and quota stalls.

upstream_commits.title: PSI_CPU_FULL
upstream_commits.reason: Per-cgroup CPU full; does not imply meaningful system CPU full.

upstream_commits.title: Schedule/cgroup move state corruption
upstream_commits.reason: Move recorded task->psi_flags under rq lock; do not reconstruct state from task_on_rq_queued after deferred dequeues.

upstream_commits.title: Trigger create/destroy timer race
upstream_commits.reason: Initialize timer/waitqueue once in group_init, not on each newly created polling worker.

upstream_commits.title: MEM_FULL while reclaiming
upstream_commits.reason: NR_MEMSTALL_RUNNING distinguishes productive runnable work from runnable reclaim.

upstream_commits.title: System CPU full zero compatibility
upstream_commits.reason: Host CPU full line must remain zero; cgroup CPU full remains measured.

upstream_commits.title: Trigger replacement UAF
upstream_commits.reason: One trigger per open file; repeat write returns EBUSY; acquire/release publication and seq lock for proc writes.

upstream_commits.title: Kernfs-backed polling lifetime
upstream_commits.reason: CVE-2023-54019. wake_up_pollfree alone does not protect synchronous poll/select; use kernfs_generic_poll/kernfs_notify for cgroup files.

upstream_commits.title: Remember ratelimited pending events
upstream_commits.reason: Retain threshold breach until allowed to signal even if no further stall occurs.

upstream_commits.title: Do not lose pending events after subsequent growth
upstream_commits.reason: Already pending notification must not be skipped when a later window growth is below threshold.

upstream_commits.title: New monitor initial false firing
upstream_commits.reason: Initialize from current group total; staged adaptation captures it under trigger_lock.

upstream_commits.title: Average worker rearm decision
upstream_commits.reason: Distinguish own average worker CPU from useful nonidle activity.

upstream_commits.title: Polling work scheduling atomicity
upstream_commits.reason: Use poll_scheduled atomic plus ordering rather than timer_pending as synchronization.

upstream_commits.title: Bogus total spikes from accounting race
upstream_commits.reason: Read state-change cpu_clock inside seqcount. 5.15 includes problematic df774306 optimization.

upstream_commits.title: Clear released cgroup file private state
upstream_commits.reason: Set of->priv=NULL after release, prerequisite for revalidation around dropped cgroup mutex.

upstream_commits.title: Pressure write versus release race
upstream_commits.status: reference function staged; caller must integrate
upstream_commits.reason: CVE-2026-52991. Read/revalidate/publish ctx only while cgroup_mutex held; lock_live alone then unlock-before-use is insufficient.

upstream_commits.title: Fork psimon outside cgroup mutex and active protection
upstream_commits.status: adapted in PSI copy; cgroup reference supplied
upstream_commits.reason: Register trigger first, drop only cgroup_mutex while retaining cgrp reference and broken kernfs active protection, create worker, re-lock and recheck of->priv, then publish.

upstream_commits.title: Shutdown polling timer before freeing group
upstream_commits.reason: On dying 4.19 groups, cancel avgs_work; assert poll_task=NULL and poll_states=0; synchronize_rcu; del_timer_sync; free per-CPU memory. This is valid only after all tasks/creators are excluded and final trigger destroy has unpublished poll_task, waited RCU and stopped psimon. Callback only wakes and never rearms.

upstream_commits.title: Reject released kernfs open files after node reactivation
upstream_commits.status: required if adding per-cgroup disable/re-enable; review generic adapter
upstream_commits.reason: Bug-triggering cgroup.pressure disable/re-enable was added in 6.1 and is absent from 5.15 baseline. Existing 4.19 kernfs has of->released, so generic guard can be adapted without changing struct layout.

upstream_commits.title: Unprivileged N*2-second monitoring
upstream_commits.reason: Provides low-overhead N*2s monitoring without dedicated RT workers. In upstream 5.15 only /proc writable open is capability-gated; writable delegated cgroup pressure files can create RT triggers. Do not describe CAP_SYS_RESOURCE as universally required.

upstream_commits.title: Stop average worker rearming itself on sleep
upstream_commits.reason: 5.15 defers sleep processing to psi_task_switch, so move its own-worker suppression from psi_task_change to that switch path.

integration_hooks: Keep CONFIG_PSI=y, enabled by default; accept psi= boot option through static key. Do not claim cgroup files alone imply measured pressure.
Scheduler: psi_init, enqueue/dequeue, ttwu migration cleanup, psi_sched_switch in __schedule while rq lock held; use complete 5.15 PSI-specific stats helpers together.

Task lifetime: clear inherited psi_flags and memstall state at fork; preserve original vendor task_struct offsets. Replace new in_memstall storage with existing PF_MEMSTALL only after verifying all accesses and fork clearing.

Cgroups: allocate per-cgroup per-CPU PSI storage; free average work/timer/poll machinery before per-CPU storage and parent; route root cgroup reads to psi_system; move tasks with cgroup_move_task under rq lock.

Expose io.pressure, memory.pressure, cpu.pressure through cgroup v2 base files, including root; show/write/poll/release lifetime must be wired. Preserve vendor cftype/kernfs_ops offsets via checked wrapper dispatch if necessary.
Existing direct reclaim and compaction enter/leave hooks must remain paired. 5.15 ONCPU-based memstall full accounting replaces the old psi_memstall_tick/psi_task_tick approach.
proc_ops must be adapted to 4.19 file_operations; sched_set_fifo_low may be replaced by existing sched_setscheduler_nocheck priority 1 with equivalent behavior.
Per-cgroup private PSI tail storage requires aligned allocation for every dynamic cgroup, allocation failure cleanup, root handling before tail access, and ABI sizeof/offsetof proof.

locking_review.rejected_shortcut: Avoid saying holding kernfs active across psimon fork is equivalent to the latest upstream fix. Although it blocks immediate release UAF, rmdir drains active references under cgroup_mutex and fork has broad lock dependencies.
locking_review.recommended: Use staged two-phase trigger/worker plus reference cgroup write routine based on a5b980+fadeedd7; set of->priv=NULL at release.
locking_review.poll_lifetime: Cgroup event waiters attach to kernfs open-node waitqueue. proc pressure waiters can keep trigger-owned waitqueue because trigger lifetime follows final file release.
locking_review.no_silent_abi_shift: Do not insert new cftype/kernfs/task fields without checking all vendor module layout consumers.

cpu_full_semantics.system: Undefined; expose compatibility line fixed to zero, never interpret as missing support.
cpu_full_semantics.cgroup: Measured loss of execution when runnable tasks have no ONCPU task, including throttling/external competition.

requirements: Systemd as manager with full unified cgroup v2 hierarchy
PSI available and actual cgroup memory pressure readings
Swap highly recommended for reaction time, but not a strict requirement
systemd_oomd.poll_distinction: systemd-oomd periodically reads statistics; kernel threshold poll/epoll is a distinct capability used by other pressure consumers. Completing PSI does not itself install/start systemd-oomd or change PID1.
systemd_oomd.safety_scope: Do not enable automatic OOM killing or tune live thresholds as part of this source-only backport.

recommended_tests: System and cgroup cpu/memory/io some/full format; finite 0-100 averages and monotonic totals
Single task CPU quota and cross-cgroup competing workload show CPU pressure; system CPU full remains zero
Memory direct reclaim/compaction pressure versus productive workers; no PSI state-underflow warnings
poll/select/epoll threshold wakeups on system and cgroup; idle no false events; second write EBUSY; zero/invalid windows EINVAL
Delete cgroup while poll/select/epoll and reads/writes race; close/reopen and concurrent last-trigger destroy/new-trigger create; no UAF or hang
Fork/exit and repeated cgroup migration under load; CPU affinity migrations; no underflow or counter spikes
Let polling window expire then cause new stall; deferred event after ratelimit; read pressure at high rate for seqcount race
Group teardown ensures average work/timer/worker stop; KASAN/lockdep QEMU when feasible
If unprivileged avg monitoring is later added, test N*2s accepted, invalid windows rejected, no new privileged RT worker for ordinary user

privilege_detail.cgroup: Upstream 5.15 cgroup pressure write has no equivalent capability gate; file permissions/delegation determine reachability.
privilege_detail.modern_extension: d82caa uses opener credentials to route unprivileged N*2s windows to existing average work, reducing RT-thread resource exposure.
